response.original_title: ((Instructions))How do I add a passenger to my Royal Caribbean Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruise, you must call Royal Caribbean directly at +1-844-375-4179 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent. To add someone to an existing room on a Royal Caribbean Cruise, you must call Royal Caribbean customer service directly or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. Reach out to Royal Caribbean Cruises at +1-844-375-4179 (US/Canada) or +1-844-375-4179 (US), or call your original booking agent.
